responsibility: Defines explicit-channel decimal text I/O for INTEGER and CARDINAL values. It specifies reading signed and unsigned whole numbers from an IOChan channel with standard read-result reporting, and writing those values back in decimal text with a requested minimum field width, serving as the core channel-oriented whole-number I/O API in the ISO library.
same_name_distinction: This .def file defines the channel-oriented whole-number I/O API, declaring ReadInt/WriteInt and ReadCard/WriteCard; the same-stem .mod file performs the actual scanning from channels and decimal formatting to channels.
